topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I stood there, the gift box in my hands, its weight a curious puzzle. It's not that I didn't appreciate the gesture; it was just unexpected, coming from a student who had been so quiet, so often lost in the back of the room. I traced the ribbon, remembering the way their eyes would follow the chalk as I wrote on the board, how they never quite reached out. Opening it, I found a book, its pages already marked with thoughtful notes. It’s a thoughtful gift, one that feels like a missed opportunity to reach out, to notice more. I’ll have to send a thank you note, maybe even call, to let them know how much it means.
